title: ‘Cocky’ Florida Man Allegedly Exposed Himself to Family During Road Rage
description:
Bodycam footage shows Florida deputies confronting a 56-year-old suspect about a road rage incident on June 23. The Lake County Sheriff’s Office said a caller claimed a man fitting James Box’s description allegedly exposed himself to their family. The witness said Box looked “deranged,” hanging himself out his window while allegedly road-raging. Box was arrested and pleaded not guilty. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
